name: section-video
title: Video Section
description: A video with its title and text in two layouts (centered, split): a 16:9 cover with a play control that embeds the video only behind your consent gate, and links to it without one; colours, fonts and radius from the project's design system

layouts.title: Centered
layouts.description: The title and text centred above the video, in one column; the default.
layouts.usage: <VideoSection layout="centered" Gate={ConsentGate} content={{ title, text, video }} />

layouts.title: Split
layouts.description: The title and text beside the video from md (the video the wider column), above it on a phone.
layouts.usage: <VideoSection layout="split" content={{ title, text, video: { title, href, poster } }} />

proof: installs alone on Next 16; two layouts (centered, split); a gated video, its host not asked before consent; links out without JS; 3 sample brands, light and dark, 390/768/1280 px, 2 hosts; axe clean
postMessage: See components/section-video/README.md for the layouts, how to put the video behind your consent gate (Gate={ConsentGate}), the poster, the labels (German included) and the design tokens it reads.
